name: Anvil Scanner
description: Security scanning, container auditing, and automated hardening for OpenClaw deployments. Provides tools for running host and OpenClaw-specific security assessments directly from agents.

binaryPath.description: Optional custom path to the anvil-scanner binary. Defaults to 'anvil-scanner' in PATH.

defaultSudo.description: Whether to prefix commands with sudo by default (recommended for full scans).

timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for anvil-scanner to complete (in seconds).

tools.name: run_security_scan
tools.description: Run a full security scan using Anvil Scanner. Returns structured findings for host security, OpenClaw audit, threat intelligence, and optional container security. Can generate HTML/JSON reports.

includeThreatIntel.description: Whether to include threat intelligence (Shodan, AbuseIPDB, etc.). Default: true

includeAI.description: Whether to request an AI-generated risk narrative (requires AI keys configured on the host). Default: false

skipOpenClaw.description: Skip the built-in OpenClaw audit integration.

outputFormat.description: How to return the results. 'summary' = concise text, 'json' = full structured data.

tools.name: audit_openclaw_containers
tools.description: Specifically audit running OpenClaw containers for security issues (privileged mode, exposed ports, sensitive mounts, user context, etc.). This is a focused, high-value check for OpenClaw operators.

tools.name: apply_hardening
tools.description: Apply recommended security hardening (SSH crypto settings, firewall rules, fail2ban configuration, etc.). Use with caution. Changes can be fully reverted with the revert_changes tool.

dryRun.description: Show what would be changed without applying anything.

tools.name: revert_changes
tools.description: Safely revert all changes previously made by Anvil Scanner (SSH config, firewall rules, etc.). This is one of the strongest safety features of the tool.

force.description: Force revert even if some backups are missing.

tools.name: get_latest_report
tools.description: Retrieve the most recent security report generated by Anvil Scanner (in text summary form).
